name: Kid vs. Kat
description: Ten-year-old Coop Burtonburger's life takes a turn for the worse when his little sister, Millie, brings home a mysterious stray cat who, in reality, is an evil cybernetic alien in disguise. To make matters worse, neither his family nor anyone else believes him, except for his best friend, Dennis. Now, Coop risks his life every day as he attempts to foil the cat's diabolical schemes and prove to the world that the family pet is an evil mastermind.

videos.title: All Washed Up
videos.overview: The daily battle between Coop and Kat end up in the bathtub and the fight continues ending in the bathroom flood of floods.

videos.title: Catboy Update
videos.overview: Lorne and Harley are filming a 'Catboy Update' film and allow Kat to take possion of a leaf-blower and it's a fight to the finish into Old Lady Munson's yard.

videos.title: Dental Damage
videos.overview: Coop's at the denist's office where Kat distracts the denist and trys some surgery of his own. Coop frees himself and the fight is on with the office being the loosing end.

videos.title: Don't Toy With Me!
videos.overview: Back to School shopping with the family and Kat finds a chance to make things really ruff for Coop who's found a toy he really wants.

videos.title: Extra Special Delivery
videos.overview: Coop hits a ball into Phoebe's house and has to retrieve it. He's followed in by Kat who at first trys to mess things up for Coop but has problems of his own by the name of Honeyfluff.

videos.title: Fishy Frisky Bitty Kitty
videos.overview: Kat gets a taste and the new and improved Fishy Frisky Bits Cat Food and seems to enjoy it a bit too much.

videos.title: Fumblebee
videos.overview: Kat's napping is interruped by a little bumblebee and the fight is on.

videos.title: Kaponk!
videos.overview: Coop begins working on his paddleball record and finally annoys Kat who begins to try and wreck his plans.

videos.title: Movie Mayhem
videos.overview: Coop and Dennis are at the movie theatre enjoying a 3D movie. Kat plants a cell phone on Coop and calls it bothering the entire theatre. Coop heads for the lobby to clean up where Kat starts the attack. In the end there's a real-to-life looking 3D fight on-stage.

videos.title: Pasta Disasta
videos.overview: Coop's family dinner out at the local pasta place is interrupted by Kat who has been smuggled in by Millie and the fight is on.

videos.title: Run Coop Run
videos.overview: Cat subsitutes Coop's soccer ball for one with a built-in time bomb. Coop and Dennis run off trying to find a place to drop the ball to explode. No matter where they go they keep finding reasons the ball can't go there. Kicking the ball between them in panic, the ball winds up next to Kat. And the exploding ball scores!

videos.title: Sky High Dive
videos.overview: A day at the pool finds Kat placing some super-bouncing gook on the diving board as Coop prepares to dazzle his friend with a really high dive that ends of leaving Old Lady Munson without her favorite soap-opera and Kat high-and-wet.

videos.title: Slap Shots
videos.overview: Hockey Practice is interrupted by a classic Coop vs Kat on the ice

videos.title: A Squirrel Wind Adventure
videos.overview: Kat tries to attack some birds in a feeder and a squirrell scares them off. Kat knocks the squirrell off the feeder and drop-kicks it out of the yard. A short time later Kat's being hit by an acorn everywhere he goes. A chase of a squirrel winds up back in the yard and Kat learns that squirrels stick together.

videos.title: Boy Meats Grill
videos.overview: Dad offers Coop a chance at a passage to manhood. Kat finds that this does not meat his approval and a fight is on. Can Coop pass the mustard?

videos.title: Boys vs. Bus
videos.overview: Lorne and Harley oversleep and miss the school bus and have quite the adventure catching up to it only to find out that it's Saturday.

videos.title: Catboy
videos.overview: Lorne and Harley rock out with a 'Catboy' music video featuring the battles between Coop and Kat.

videos.title: Come Wail Away
videos.overview: As Kat joins a bunch of wailing cats, Coop mistakes it for a signal of an alien invasion and sets out to wake up the entire town in alarm. It's a musical interruption at the end by Old Lady Munson that really alarms the citizens.

videos.title: Geriatric Joust
videos.overview: Millie heads for the nursing home with Coop and Kat with the idea that Kat can be a companion cat. Kat seems to be taking it well until Coop tries to break it up and head for home, and the house-raising battle begins.

videos.title: Itty Bitty Kitty Committee
videos.overview: Coop discovers that Kat has shed his skin, leaving catnipian termites, after broken by Coop.

videos.title: Katnapped!
videos.overview: Coop goes into Kat's brain to mess with Kat's dreams to make them his worst nightmare, but it's a big nightmare for Coop.

videos.title: Laser Guided Furball
videos.overview: As Millie and Phoebe play make over, Kat begins using a laser pointer in his finger to tease Honeyfluff and uses that to begin a fight with Coop. It's Kid vs Kat vs Cat.

videos.title: Lions and Tigers and Kat... Oh My!
videos.overview: A trip to the zoo has Kat trying to make time with a lady lion only to have the King of the Beast set off a fight beween the other animals and Kat with Kat taking the loosing end all the way.

videos.title: Pretty Kitty
videos.overview: Family picture day has Millie and Dad dropping off Kat at the groomers. Kat does not take to being groomed. After finishing off the groomers, it's between Coop and Kat with Dad and Millie walking into the middle of the fight with the result being a hair-raising picture.

videos.title: Whiskering Heights
videos.overview: A dog chases Kat up a tree and Millie sends out an alarm that Kat is stuck in the tree. When Kat does not want to come down, not the fire department, a SWAT team or the Army can get him out of that tree, but Coop knows the way.

videos.title: You and Whose Armour?
videos.overview: Coop makes a Kat-Proof-Suit out of an old washing machine. It seems to work until Kat breaks out the old steam roller.

videos.title: Let the Games Begin
videos.overview: Coop Burtonburger has his first run in with Kat when his little sister brings the feline home.

videos.title: Night of the Zombie Kat
videos.overview: Coop watches a horror movie, then after, Kat uses flour to make his skin white and scare Coop.

videos.title: Trespassers Will Be Persecuted
videos.overview: Old Lady Munson lays down the law; Coop is not to set foot into her yard, but Kat makes sure he crosses the line again, again and again.

videos.title: Me-Oh-Me-Oh Meow
videos.overview: After meowing too much, Kat is forced to wear a special collar, but in the end Kat straps the collar onto Coop's foot.

videos.title: Do Not Fort Sake Me
videos.overview: Coop and Dennis build a tree fort, where Kat used it to power-up his collar because the tree's fort was very tall, so Kat's climbed it and starting communicating with other "Kats".

videos.title: Cookie D'uh
videos.overview: Coop gets accused of stealing cookies.

videos.title: Nip/Duck
videos.overview: Coop is determined to find out the truth about Kat when Kat's mysterious X-rays are destroyed.

videos.title: Search and De-Toy
videos.overview: Coop comes up with a plan to rescue his dad's (possibly his) helicopter from Old Lady Munson.

videos.title: Flu the Coop
videos.overview: Tensions mount when Coop is sick and Kat is none too pleased, and why shall you ask? Because germs irritate Kat's skin.

videos.title: Class Act
videos.overview: Coop finds some magic stuff in Dad's store and uses it to do a magic act to make Kat disappear forever.

videos.title: Hypnokat
videos.overview: Kat's new toy mouse hypnotizes the other cats in the neighborhood, and Kat seizes the opportunity to create his own cat army.

videos.title: The Allergy
videos.overview: Coop convinces Dad that he's allergic to Kat so Dad will get rid of the pesky feline for good. Kat turns the tables on Coop, convincing Dad that he's allergic to Coop as well!

videos.title: Just Me and Glue
videos.overview: When Coop and Kat get glued hand to paw, they are forced to spend the day together. Kat turns out to be a big help in putting together Coop's new Mechanizor Warrior model robot until Coop realizes Kat has programmed it to destroy Coop, but Kat will also be destroyed.

videos.title: You'll Be Show Sorry
videos.overview: When a contest for pets is announced in Bootsville, Coop subscribes Kat because the winner wins a trip around the world. However, Coop regrets this when he realizes he will be taking the trip with Kat if he wins.

videos.title: How the Test Was Won
videos.overview: As Coop prepares for a big test, Kat comes up with multiple ways to distract him from studying, which in the end, Kat ironically helps Coop remember the things he should study thus having a B+ on the test.

videos.title: I'm Okay, You're a Kat
videos.overview: Coop discovers a self-help motivational tape in the House of Swap and turns his life around, until Kat uses the tape to remove Coop’s new-found power of perfect positivity. Now it's up to Coop to use the tapes to fight evil Kat with an even more evil Coop!

videos.title: Dial "B" For Babysitter
videos.overview: Coop has his work cut out for him when he's forced to babysit Kat, Old Lady Munson, and her dog Growler.

videos.title: The Grass is Always Meaner
videos.overview: Coop comes up with a plan to make money for a Captain Blasteroid Helmet by cutting Old Lady Munson's lawn; Kat tries to stop Coop and Dennis by making the grass grow.

videos.title: One Big, Happy Family
videos.overview: The only way to convince Dad that Coop's not the one causing all the destruction is for Coop to never leave his father's sight. But this puts Dad and Millie right in the line of fire. Coop's got to keep on his toes if he wants his family to survive.

videos.title: Happy Campers
videos.overview: Dad competes with Dennis' father as to who's the best camper during a family weekend in the woods. Coop and Dennis use their knowledge of the forest to lead Kat into escalating confrontations with nature.

videos.title: U.F. Float
videos.overview: Bootsville's annual parade has a Spaced Out theme this year and Dad wants to advertise the House of Swap with a Flying Saucer float.

videos.title: Play N'Ice
videos.overview: Dad builds an ice palace and rink in the backyard.

videos.title: House of Scream
videos.overview: Kat takes advantage of Dad turning the House of Swap into a horror fun house by going for real blood.

videos.title: Planter's Warp
videos.overview: Coop brings home a carrot suspended in a glass of water for a science project.

videos.title: Curse of Tutankitty's Tomb
videos.overview: Egyptian artifacts at the museum turn out to be high-tech relics from Kat's world.

videos.title: Pet Peeved
videos.overview: When Millie finds a new school friend exactly like her, she starts to ignore Kat.

videos.title: Don't Give Me No Static
videos.overview: Desperate for a completed science project, Coop borrows one of Kat's weird machines without knowing what it does.

videos.title: Storm Drained
videos.overview: Coop is determined to have Bootsville win against Timber Lane in a baseball game.

videos.title: Fishy Frisky Business
videos.overview: On a family shopping trip, Kat gets Coop banned from the grocery store.

videos.title: Teed Off
videos.overview: Dennis and Coop's fathers encourage them to revive a neighbourhood tradition, the 'round the block golf challenge.

videos.title: Something Fishy In Owl Lake
videos.overview: The Burtonburgers face friends, neighbours, and each other in a local Fishing Derby.

videos.title: Dire Education
videos.overview: Dad comes to school to shadow the kids on Parents' Day.

videos.title: Crouching Cooper, Hidden Kat
videos.overview: When Kat and Millie embarrass Coop in front of the school by flipping him, he turns to Dennis for martial arts lessons.

videos.title: Tom-Kat Foolery
videos.overview: Coop's April fool's day jokes have the entire town not believing a word he says, so how can Coop stop what seems to be a Kat led UFO invasion when even Dennis assumes it to be Coop's biggest joke yet?

videos.title: In Dog We Trust
videos.overview: Seeing how freaked out Kat gets by a huge stray dog, Coop adopts it as his pet and bodyguard, but the dog is a lot more responsibility then he thought, especially after Coop's plan backfires, as Kat retrains it to destroy the house.

videos.title: Catch My Drift
videos.overview: Kat overcomes his fear of snow to make sure Coop gets chilly in the Demolition Run tobogganing challenge.

videos.title: Suddenly Last Slammer
videos.overview: The police and Old Lady Munson catch Coop and his friends waking the neighborhood.

videos.title: The Kitty Vanishes
videos.overview: Kat struggles to perfect a teleporter to transfer Fishy Frisky Bits across space to his home.

videos.title: Capture the Kat
videos.overview: Kat wants a day off, but Coop and the gang play capture the flag right through to his secret forest oasis.

videos.title: Outer Space Case
videos.overview: When OLM shows an unusual interest in Coop and Dennis' favourite show, they become equally obsessed with finding out why she likes it.

videos.title: Buzz Off!
videos.overview: It's time for the annual Bootsville Days festival celebrating the town's founding. Coop is in a real Battle of the Bugs!

videos.title: Fat Kat
videos.overview: Kat's been eating too many treats and how he is tipping the scales with rolls of flab!

videos.title: Kat Whisperer
videos.overview: After Coop uses cat whispering to make Kat into his new best friend, he becomes a pal to all animals.

videos.title: Bend It Like Burtonburger
videos.overview: Coop and Dennis join the soccer team but Coop would rather show off than use teamwork.

videos.title: Stall That Jazz
videos.overview: When Kat's listening transmitter becomes lodged in his ear, his hearing becomes super sensitive.

videos.title: Under Destruction
videos.overview: After Kat's latest tantrum almost destroys the house, Dad starts his own extreme renovation.

videos.title: Beware the Were-Coop
videos.overview: After Kat scratches Coop, he believes that he's turning into a were-cat.

videos.title: Trick or Threat
videos.overview: On Halloween, Coop and Dennis plan on trick or treating... much to Kat's dismay.

videos.title: Hack Kattack
videos.overview: Kat uses a universal remote control to try and hack into Earth's computer systems.

videos.title: It's a Rocket, Man
videos.overview: Both Coop and Kat join a local rocket club and Coop becomes a big star. Unfortunately, Kat plans on using Coop's rocket to destroy a satellite in space.

videos.title: Kid vs. Kat vs. Christmas (1)
videos.overview: Coop's hopes of a normal Christmas are shattered by the fact that Kat is constantly getting him in trouble; it is revealed that Kat really misses his family back at his home planet. Coop and Millie's grandparents are expected to visit for the Christmas, but many troubles cause them to be late.

videos.title: Something About Fiona
videos.overview: Coop falls for Old Lady Munson’s niece Fiona, and Kat does everything he can to make Coop look bad.

videos.title: Tickled Pink
videos.overview: When Millie tickles Mr. Kat's 'tickle spot' he goes into a blissful state that renders him useless as an alien agent and when Kat's empire find out about him they send a robot to destroy Millie.

videos.title: Flea Brains
videos.overview: Kat's swarm of flea-sized mind control robots hop into the ears of the people of Bootsville and soon they all destroy Coop.

videos.title: Menace the Dennis
videos.overview: With Coop out of town, Kat wants to turn water into milk and Dennis comes to the rescue.

videos.title: Cheeks of Evil
videos.overview: Millie brings home the class hamster, unaware that Mr. Kat hates hamsters.

videos.title: Reap it and Weep
videos.overview: When Kat uses his growth ray to bury Bootsville in a catnip jungle, Coop is blamed by the irate Bootsville Gardening Club.

videos.title: Blasteroid Blues
videos.overview: Coop tries to stop the destruction of Massive Mart.

videos.title: Rat-a-Phooey
videos.overview: Kat builds a Rat-ray gun, which he plans on using to turn Coop into a rat, but Dad gets zapped instead, so Coop hopes he can change Dad back... If he can catch him first!

videos.title: Trash Talking
videos.overview: Coop and Dennis climb inside Kat's scratching post and discover Kat's alien technology has created an infinity within.

videos.title: Over the Radar
videos.overview: Coop, Millie, and Dad are taken away to a top secret base to be interrogated, after a UFO investigator suspects they are aliens.

videos.title: 'Nuff Said
videos.overview: After taking the fall for one too many of Kat's destructive escapades, Coop decides to let Kat have free rein to cause whatever destruction he wants.

videos.title: Rhymes With Coop
videos.overview: Due to an ‘over-loading’ problem on the Kat Nebula, Kat plots to turn Bootsville Beach into a giant litter box.

videos.title: Bringin' the Heat
videos.overview: Kat’s devious magnifier satellite is causing a dangerous heat wave in Bootsville.

videos.title: The Three Aarghs
videos.overview: Coop and Dennis compete with one another to reduce their carbon footprints.

videos.title: Kat to the Future (1)
videos.overview: Coop uses Kat’s time machine to go back to the past and stop Millie from bringing Kat home, but ends up altering the future for the worse.

videos.title: Kat to the Future (2)
videos.overview: Coop tries to undo the Kat invasion, which he brought about by fooling with Kat’s time machine.

videos.title: Down the Drain
videos.overview: Coop becomes Dennis’ wing-man for a change, as they go in search of the 'sewer-croc-baby'.

videos.title: 9 to 5 to Oblivion
videos.overview: Coop breaks every window in Dennis' house, and is forced to work off his debt by working in Henry's store.

videos.title: When Bad Dogs Go Big
videos.overview: Growler swallows a Kat device which makes him grow to the size of a T-Rex.

videos.title: The Bottyguard
videos.overview: Kat's malfunctioning spybot thinks Coop is its new master, and wants to protect him from Kat.

videos.title: Rebel with a Claw
videos.overview: The Kat Kommander's rebellious son runs away to Earth, where he becomes a handful for Kat, and a danger to the human race.

videos.title: Swap Wrecked
videos.overview: Dad accidentally swaps an assortment of Kat's weapons to the unwitting residents of Bootsville.

videos.title: Hit the Road
videos.overview: Kat is left at a kennel while the Burtonburgers go on vacation.

videos.title: Never Cry Sheep
videos.overview: Kat becomes obsessed with making the biggest yarn ball ever made, and starts rustling sheep to gather their wool.

videos.title: Kickin' Butler
videos.overview: Dennis is accidentally knocked into a portal around the world.

videos.title: You Kat See Me
videos.overview: Kat makes himself invisible and causes trouble for Coop on the night he invites Fiona to dinner and when Dad invites Coop's teacher over for dinner.

videos.title: Keep on Rockin'
videos.overview: Coop's grandparents visit, so Dad buys them rocking chairs. However, it turns out they are adventure junkies who accept that Kat is an alien.

videos.title: It's in the Bag
videos.overview: Coop searches for the last available bag of the feline's favorite food after the factory that makes it closes down so he can taunt Kat.

videos.title: King of the Pipsqueaks
videos.overview: Old Lady Munson's garden gnomes come to life and mistake Coop as their leader.

videos.title: Down the Creek
videos.overview: Old Lady Munson tells Millie creative stories about her adventures in the past.

videos.title: Turn the Other Cheeks
videos.overview: The evil alien hamster Mr. Cheeks comes back to get revenge on his nemesis, Kat.

videos.title: Birthday Bashed
videos.overview: Coop's birthday is here, and everyone is coming to his party, and Phoebe is trying to get rid of Fiona so she can have Coop to herself. Meanwhile, Kat is trying to enjoy a virtual picnic in a secluded spot with his girlfriend, but the kids and Coop keep crashing Coop's birthday.

videos.title: Mind Games
videos.overview: Dad orders Coop to spend more quality time with his little sister; Kat builds a telepathy helmet.

videos.title: Strange Kat on a Train
videos.overview: Coop goes on a train to buy something from a man named Old Herman, Unfortunately it turns out to be the evil alien hamster, Mr. Cheeks!

videos.title: Board Kat
videos.overview: Coop and Kat fight over the animal's new lightning box generator and end up swapping brains.

videos.title: The Treasure of Sierra Munson
videos.overview: Coop discovers buried treasure under Old Lady Munson's house.

videos.title: Fangs for the Memories
videos.overview: Kat's memory eraser leads to Coop forgetting Kat is an evil alien, but Dad accidentally gets Coop's lost memories and suddenly knows the terrible truth.

videos.title: Drive-In Me Crazy
videos.overview: Kat builds a device that brings an assortment of movie monsters to life.

videos.title: Hair Brains
videos.overview: Coop and Dennis battle Kat's army of living hairballs.

videos.title: Hot Dog Day
videos.overview: It's Hot Dog Day, and Coop has the honor of being named Keeper of the Weiner Water. But Kat wants to ruin the most special day of the year.

videos.title: Amazing Feet of Strength
videos.overview: Kat soups up Coop's new soccer shoes to allow the wearer to run faster and jump higher, and Coop wears the shoes in the championship game.

videos.title: Me Coop, You Kat
videos.overview: Kat turns Coop into a cave man, hoping his lowered I.Q. will make him easier to outsmart. Now Dennis must change Coop back to human.

videos.title: You Scream, I Scream
videos.overview: Coop takes on the teen aged bully who pedals the Curly Swirl Ice Cream cart, and forgets to pay attention to Kat's latest evil plans.

videos.title: Good Luck Harm
videos.overview: Kat makes himself a high-powered good luck charm, which means bad luck for Coop.

videos.title: Bootsville's Most Wanted
videos.overview: Buck Diamond, Animal Protection Officer declares Coop "Bootsville's Most Wanted".

videos.title: Kat of Diamonds
videos.overview: Coop and Fiona have to settle their argument before they can work together to stop Kat in his evil tracks.

videos.title: Coop D'Etat
videos.overview: Kat and Old Lady Munson show up at school where they work together to make Coop's life miserable.

videos.title: The Incredible Shrinking Coop
videos.overview: Kat shrinks Coop and Dennis down to size and tries to squash them like bugs, which makes it hard for Coop to do something big for Dad for Father's Day.

videos.title: Who's Haunting Who?
videos.overview: Kat thinks the haunted LeBoot Mansion will be the perfect place for an inter-space teleporter.

videos.title: It's All in Your Head
videos.overview: Kat controls the mind of Agent Napolitan, but his plan backfires when some squirrels attack him.

videos.title: The Kat Went Back (1)
videos.overview: When Kat is fired for incompetence the Robo-Kat-Kops that are sent to take him home also capture Coop, Dennis, Fiona, Millie, Lorne, and Harley and take them to the Kat Planet.

videos.title: The Kat Went Back (2)
videos.overview: Coop and the rest of the kids need Kat's help to escape Kat Planet. Will he give it?
